properties.name: Tumor sims with CA
properties.description:
We developed a tumor growth and therapy simulation using Cellular Automata. The simulation was used to study time series of fractal dimension and entropy as the tumor develops.

You can consult the paper at:
https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jtbi.2023.111462

properties.name: Angiogenesis simulation with CA
properties.description:
Studied how angiogenic vascular network properties influence tumor development, and how the disruption of this network could be used in cancer therapy.

The full paper can be consulted at:

https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chaos.2024.115199

properties.name: CA simulation of immunotherapy + autoimmune disease
properties.description:
Drawing from previous CA works, we developed a simulation that allowed us to study the interaction between autoimmune diseases, inflammation, immunotherapy, and cancer.

The full paper can be consulted here:

https://doi.org/10.1016/j.apm.2025.116315

properties.name: Automated walkability assessment in Mexico and Mumbai
properties.description:
Developed an automated street-view-based system for assessing infrastructure close to transport stations in Monterrey, Mexico, and Mumbai, India.

The paper for this project is under review.

properties.name: SEM study of walkability in Monterrey
properties.description:
We proposed an SEM based on survey data collected at two transport stations in Monterrey: Cuauhtémoc and San Nicolás. Findings highlighted the importance of safety perception when walking in Mexico.

The paper for this project is under review.

properties.name: SEM study of the impact of sociodemographic factors on walkability in Monterrey and Mumbai
properties.description: We are developing an SEM-MIMIC model to study the impact of factors like area familiarity, socioeconomic conditions, and gender on walkability near transport stations in Monterrey and Mumbai.

properties.name: Development of a cluster-then-predict method to improve building height estimations
properties.description: Proposed a novel method that combines (1) street-view imagery and (2) footprints to improve building height estimates and provide this information for data-scarce contexts.

properties.name: Street-view route recommendations systems for Mexico City
properties.description:
For CS7375, I developed a walking route recommendation system for Mexico City. The system takes into consideration (1) the conditions of the infrastructure that are observed at street level (e.g., presence of sidewalks, streetlights, vegetation), and (2) qualitative attributes left by other users for routes that are similar to the ones displayed to the user.

The continuation of this work is pending.

properties.name: Analysis of the relation between building materials and environmental sensor data
properties.description:
For this study, we are

1. Combining street-view and satellite data to obtain maps for temperature and PM2.5 around Northeastern's Boston campus.

2. Analyzing the relationship between building materials and the environmental variables to provide urban design recommendations.

properties.name: Imageable library development
properties.description: We developed the Imageable library, which automatically labels building height and façade materials for footprint data.
